batting.name: BR Dunk
batting.dismissal: c Yuvraj Singh b HV Patel

batting.name: CM Gautam
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b VR Aaron

batting.name: CJ Anderson
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b YS Chahal

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c CJ Anderson b P Suyal

batting.name: RR Rossouw
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b SL Malinga

batting.name: MA Starc
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b SL Malinga

balls.text: Rohit ends the innings with a clean boundary, this was pitched up outside off and he made room and carved it down to deep cover
he forces it down to long-on for a couple

Starc's won this battle! Pollard moved right across his stumps to paddle that and he missed, Rohit had set off for the bye and Parthiv underarmed it to the bowler, Pollard had no option to amble out because Rohit was already at his end, Starc gestures to Pollard to come to his end and then whips off the bails aggressively
swings and pulls a length ball down to deep midwicket and AB does a fine job running from long-on and cutting it off
this was a slower ball outside off and it was a touch too wide, Kohli thought that was unfair
another low full toss outside the off stump and he fails to put that away, down to deep midwicket
it's a low full toss outside off and he forces it down to long-on
Aaron is spared this time, Rohit backs away and swings and misses
he has reached his fifty as well! This was a short ball and he backed away and got a thick top edge that still managed to clear the rope at fine leg, he was lucky there again
this was very well timed wide of backward point and Harshal really had to sprint to his right to cut that off
14 off three balls! Aaron tries to bowl this full outside off and he makes room and it goes off the face of the bat and clears a few rows at deep cover
thudded down the ground, he makes room and smacks it over the bowler's head, went quickly
the bats these days! Rohit swings at one outside off and the ball flies off the outside edge and just clears the rope at third man
don't bowl length to Pollard! Dinda learns it the hard way, he swing it over square leg, nobody there
and now Dinda tries the short stuff on Pollard and it works as he ducks
this was aimed at a yorker length and he drills it down to long-on
going going... this was a full ball on the off stump and he bends and slogs that several rows over deep midwicket
swings and it goes on the bounce to long-on
low full toss outside off and he punches it towards deep point
and Pollar responds by whipping the last ball to deep square leg, this was a yorker aimed on leg stump
good bouncer from Starc, Pollard looks to hook but misses, Starc has some words for him, Pollard shoos him off
another misfield, Dinda again this time at square leg, didn't time his dive well again and Chahal mops up
Starc round the wicket, ,looked to paddle it and the ball rolls off the pads
good length on the body and he tucks it away to square leg
that should make Rohit feel a lot better, this was a half volley outside off and he crashed that wide of cover and picked the big gap
did that carry? Pollard was looking to drive and got an outside edge that dipped towards Yuvraj at point, dived but maybe it just dropped short
good come back as he bowls the slower ball and beats Pollard
that was a freebie, terrible ball, short and wide outside off and he arched back and carved it over extra cover
looked to run it to the on side and he nearly lobbed it back to the bowler on the full
he opens the face and steers it to third man where Dinda picks up, looks like he is okay
pushed it down to cover point and set off and there was an overthrow at the striker's end, Chahal the culprit
Pollard gives that a biff down the ground, this was flatter and he whammed it down to long-on
he gets forward and drives him down to long-off
makes room and tamely pushes it back to the bowler
fires that full and he drags it down to backward point, packed off side field
flatter one and played down to long-on
Yuvraj adds to the wides column, down the leg side
drags it short and Pollard can only bash this to long-off
bit more air and he uses his feet and drives to deep cover
makes room and pushes it to the off side for a single
drops it short and he makes room and slaps it down to deep cover
on the pads and tucked to the leg side
this outfield was quick, Pollard gently dabbed this late wide of short third man and beats Dinda, he chases and dives awkwardly and his left shoulder doesn't look good, he is in pain, looked serious

turns it towards square leg and Pollard ambles out of the crease looking for a second but he exchanges looks with Gayle who has the ball, Gayle was challenging his WI team-mate to go for the run, the staring continues
drags it short again and he swivels and pulls to fine leg
he bangs this in  short and he swivels and pulls to deep square leg
outside the off stump and he punches this down to mid-off
slower ball outside off and he steers it to third man
slower through the air and he defends
gets forward and pushes it to long-off for a single
he punches it to the off side
that was a fumble from Dinda, Pollard shuffled across and scooped it over the keeper, Dinda ran from short third man and doesn't time his dive well and the ball rolls away
stays back and turns it to long-on
gives him width outside off and he steers it down to third man
plays this high on the bat and steers it to point
a bit too straight and he tucks it away to fine leg
keeps it nice and straight and he stays back and defends to mid-on
short and wide outside off and he cuts wide of point, sweeper picks up
punches it to point and decides against the single
flatter and Pollard plonks forward and defends
picks the googly late and chips it just wide of short midwicket

Anderson's second attempt at clearing long-on in the same over doesn't fetch the same result, he fetched this from outside off and slogged, went high in the air and Kohli was well in front of the rope when he took it
clips it to the on side
didn't take long for Anderson to get his eye in, this was tossed up and he fetches it from outside off, bends and slogs it flat over long-on
flatter one and worked to midwicket
that was a Test match leave from Anderson, outside off and shaping away
much easier for Parthiv this time, this was a loose drive, chasing at one angling away from him outside the off stump, thick edge and taken by Parthiv
dropped it with soft hands in front of point and sets off
yet another extra, wide down the leg side
makes room and he nudges it off his pads to the on side
good stuff from Kohli but to no avail, this was pushed to mid-off and Kohli back flicked it to the stumps on seeing the non striker leave his crease, he was back in time
loses control of that as he sprays it too wide outside off
clipped this to midwicket and thought of a run
and finally the over ends, stays forward and pushes it down the track
the middle stumps is flattened and Dinda has his revenge after leaking plenty, this was coming back in, fuller ball, Rayudu playing down the wrong line
There's a direct hit and it is being referred, Gautam fails to put away a full toss and places it to cover, sets off, then he's sent back and there's a direct hit and he was just back
Dinda gets some good inswing and lands it on a yorker length, dug out to mid-off
he stays back and looks to drive but misses
shot! This was a length ball outside off and Gautam read the length very early, swiveled and pulled it for six over deep midwicket
this time he strays down the leg side and wide called
Parthiv might want to consider standing at the boundary edge, another bouncer flies past the batsman and the keeper, first Hardhal and now Dinda
drifts on the pads and he works it to the on side
turns it to the on side for a single
top  shot down the ground, he gives Chahal the charge, gets to the pitch of it and lofts down the ground
went down the track and chipped it over cover inside out
flatter one and he gets forward and pushes it to cover
tossed up and he gets forward and works it to midwicket

this was risky, it was a full ball  chipped back towards the bowler but Harshal couldn't turn to his right on his follow through to pluck that with one hand, the timing was good enough as the ball reaches the straight boundary
too quick for everyone, bangs it in short, he makes room and looks to play the upper cut, little Parthiv couldn't get a glove on that
he moved right across the stumps and looked to play the ramp shot, didn't come off at all, the ball rolled back to the bowler
he drifts this one on the pads and he looks ti work it away and the ball rolls to the on side
looks to steer it past backward point but can't beat him
strange shot by Rayudu as he pokes his bat out and guides it to slip, didn't know whether to play or leave
he gets bat on ball and how! After being beaten repeatedly he plays a pick up shot and sends it over long leg, length ball from Aaron and too straight
bowls a fuller length and he still can't get bat on ball, he made room and went down the pitch, looked to slam it over the off side
Aaron persists with the short stuff but he is penalised, in fact Gautam took a few paces down the track, swings and misses
sharp bouncer, 145 kph, too quick for the batsman who swayed out of the way
big swing and a miss, there was late away movement for Aaron and Gautam was looking to slam it over the bowler's head, nearly took the edge, Aaron smiles
tucks him up for room and he can only steer this to the off side
a bit too straight and he easily clips it away down to fine leg
he starts off with a wide down the leg side
this was perilously close to the stumps, looked like the slower ball, Gautam was down the track, swung and missed
good comeback by Harshal as he bangs it in short and Gautam misses as he tries to upper cut
the first of the evening, shot of intent there by Gautam, he charged the bowler first and then picked a length ball on middle and sent it over deep square leg, top shot
dips it back in and he gets across and defends
close call for Rayudu straightaway, he drops the ball with soft hands on the pitch and Gautam sets off, the ball stays away from the stumps

the bowling change works for RCB, loose shot by Dunk, length ball angling in and Dunk was looking to chip this over mid-off, tamely lobbed it to Yuvraj at that position, wicket straightaway for Harshal
edgy this time, thick outside edge flies past point but third man's there
this was a good yorker swinging in on the pads and Starc appealed but the ball may have missed leg, Dinda had a shy at the stumps at the striker's end but nobody backing up
keeps it full and he flicks it straight to midwicket
good length outside off and punched to the off side
a bit too straight and flicked behind square leg, Chahal does the chasing, dives and stops the ball and the momentum takes him towards the rope but he releases the ball before he strikes the rope
stays back and knocks it to the on side

this was quite effortless from the batsman but plenty of effort from AB who tried to stop that, moves away and it was more a punch off the back foot that beat the covers, didn't hit it too hard but AB charged after it, dived in vain
this was short of a length and wide and he opens the face and steers it down to third man
this was a length ball on the pads and easily flicked away down to fine leg
smacked past backward point, this was too wide and a bit short, bent forward slightly and slashed it to deep point
fullish on middle and off and flicked down to square leg
good running, he opened the face of the bat and steered this one wide of backward point and ran the first quickly
didn't look fully in control but he found the gap very easily, this was full and wide and he really had to reach out, placed it well wide of mid-off and the quick outfield did the rest
this time he has some width and he reaches out and guides it to third man
he defends this one high on the bat and drops it to the off side
late inswing and the ball strikes the pads and rolls away, pitched on leg and not a bad shout
beats him outside the off stump, this one straightens and Gautam pokes his bat out
drifts on the pads, gets a bit of swing and he nudges it off his pads to the leg side
shuffles at the crease and pulls a slower ball down to long-on
a wide to delay the inevitable, this was short and too wide outside off, swings at it
fires that on a yorker length and he makes room and drills it to the off side
slower ball and he swings and misses and that sneaks past the stumps
drifts on the leg side and he gets an inside edge and the ball rolls to the off side
Aaron comes forward and has another free swing at a short ball and that clears the keeper
comes down the track to have a swing at Pollard and misses, slower ball
he makes room and has a swing and misses
low inswinging full toss and he gets an inside edge to the pads
the yorker length again and he makes room and carves it down to deep cover
good yorker on middle and Dinda can only drill it back to the bowler
scoops to cover, this was the slower ball by Malinga, Rossouw gave the charge and looked to clear the off side, chipped it to Rohit at cover
Rossouw's not given up on this! Malings fires a length ball, in the slot for him and he swings and sends it soaring over wide long-on
pacy delivery outside off, he makes room to swing and he's beaten
makes room and looks to slog and he gets an inside edge to the body
he pushes it behind point

knocks the off stump down this time, it was the off cutter, Harshal shuffled across and he wasn't too sure what he was trying, walked all around it and the ball brushed his hip and hit the off stump which lands a couple of yards back
Harshal showing he can tonk it too, this was fired full and he made room and swung at it and sent it a few rows over deep cover
drilled towards long-on and they set off for the second but Anderson attacks the ball and fires it to the keeper, Patel had to scamper back and dive, third umpire takes a look
full outside off and drilled down to long-off
he got his placement right, shuffles across his stumps and swings a length ball over midwicket, plenty of open space there

and as many of you would have hoped for Starc's gone and with a little help from Pollard, this was fired full outside off and he tries to clear the off side and ends up scooping it to Pollard at cover
full outside off and he fails to dig out the yorker
bit streaky, this was fired full and he sliced it and ended up getting an outside edge that cleared point
full on the off stump and he pushes it to the off side
comes down the track and forces it to long-off
drives a low full toss back to the bowler
pulled and it lobs off the glove and drops short of Malinga at short fine leg

that's a goal by Pollard! Rossouw looks to pull and gets an inside edge to the body and the ball drops in front of him, they take the single and Yuvraj was struggling, Pollard senses he wouldn't have time to pick up and throw so he settles for the kick and boots the ball towards the stumps and Yuvi was short
that was a clean hit, lobbed up on middle and he slogs him across the line, didn't hit it too hard and it went back a few rows over deep midwicket
a bit too straight and Yuvraj swings this to deep square leg, he can't find the boundary
in the air and hammered really hard down the ground and Anderson had to quickly cut that off
Dropped  by Rohit, Rossouw hammered a low full toss to the bowler's left and Rohit was a bit slow to react, it popped out and rolled behind him
Yuvraj sizes up for the big hit and he mistimes it to deep midwicket
this is a full toss and he can only push it to long-on
that was short again and Yuvraj can only pull it to long-on
he drags it short and he pulls along the ground to midwicket
that's the end of a good over, Yuvraj tucked for room and he  can only push it towards the bowler
he fires that full and he works it to midwicket
he stays back and punches it to the off side

Anderson plucks that at long-off and Kohli has to go, this was pitched up on the off stump and Kohli aims for a flat six over long-off, Anderson moved to his right quickly and judged it well, it must have thudded onto his palm because Kohli hit that hard
that was a good ball, this was on a yorker length and he got an inside edge to the boot
good length outside off and he punches it down to sweeper cover
shuffles across and he flicks it wide of square leg
he stays back and defends back to the bowler

Bumrah does what Steyn couldn't do the other night! He knocks down the leg stump as AB attempts one of his audacious sweep shots, moved right across his stumps, the angle was taking it towards the leg stump, it goes for a spin and lands a few yards back
he stays back at the crease and he punches it to midwicket
good length outside off and he punches it to the off side
full and drilled down to long-on
that confounded the fielder at sweeper cover, this was full, fast and outside off and AB didn't hit it too hard, used the pace of the ball and placed it wide of sweeper cover
Malinga was lucky to get away with this one, low full toss on the pads and whipped away and Bumrah was sharp at short fine leg
fires this on a yorker length outside the off stump and he squirts it out to point
full outside the off stump and he drills it down to long-on
nearly another boundary as AB smashed it off the front foot and went on the bounce to cover
Dropped  by Bumrah at short fine leg! Malinga drifted on the pads, Kohli flicked it fine, Bumrah moved to his right and appeared to have it covered but it came on quickly and slipped away
fires it full on the pads and he whips it to deep midwicket
turned away wide of square leg and they take the first run quickly

AB was in trouble but Gautam fumbles! Kohli dropped it to the off side and AB charged off but Kohli was quick to send him back, Gautam ran across to gather but he failed to pick up the ball properly, AB hurried back
a freebie from Pollard, down the leg side, keeper was up, all it needed was a gentle tickle
that was raw power! Half volley on the off stump and he gets forward and bashes it so hard that long-off can't cut it off
he opens the face of the bat and drops it to third man
no sighter needed, he plays the reverse sweep! There was a slip in place but that didn't deter him, placed it wide of slip

Harbhajan's got the Big Fish and Gayle can't believe it! Harbhajan bowls round the wicket and the ball straightens, Gayle was down to slog and he was too early on the shot and the ball struck the off stump, Harbhajan is on his knee and pumps his fist and stays there
Harbhajan fires that flat and quick and he whips it to square leg
over the sight screen! That was clean, Kohli saw the extra flight, came down the track and had a free swing
he comes down the track and he mistimes it to deep midwicket
he makes the mistake of drifting down leg with fine leg up, sweeps and places it fine, down to fine leg
short again and pulled down the ground to deep midwicket
drags it a bit short and he pulls with force to deep midwicket
good length and he tucks it away down to deep midwicket
length ball and softly pushed towards long-off
Gautam up to the stumps now, Kohli runs it down to short third man
gives him a warm welcome, lobbed up on the off stump and he comes down the track and lofts him just over long-off's reach
full on middle and leg and he pushes it down to long-on
flatter one and he works it away down to square leg
round the wicket to Kohli and he dances down the track, the ball hits his pad and rolls away
comes down the track and checks his shot to Malinga at short fine leg, Gayle has to hurry
tries to drive and gets an inside edge to the pad, Kohli is sent back
tossed up on middle and leg and worked to fine leg
awkward shot from Gayle as he stabbed at it to the off side
nudges it to short fine leg and Gayle has to hurry the single
slower ball on the leg side and he nudges it to fine leg

punches it down the track and Bumrah stretches his left hand and the ball hits the stumps, Gayle grounds his bat and Harbhajan is the only one interested in appealing and the bowler himself can't be bothered! I don't think it brushed the finger in the first place
Kohli gets an inside edge to the boot and the ball rolls to the off side
nothing risky about that! Tossed up and Gayle went forward and clubbed that flat over deep midwicket
that was good adjustment! Gayle was down the track and it was outside off and nearly beaten in flight, he quickly adjusted and swung across the line instead and placed it to deep midwicket
Gayle looks to sweep and he places it to square leg
turned towards square leg for a single
continues round the wicket to Kohli, he knocks it to the on side
slog and a miss, Harbhajan tosses it up from round the wicket, lands on a good length and Parthiv plays too early and the ball hits his stumps
now it's the short one and Gayle can't resist the pull, swings and misses
follows that up with a yorker to keep him quiet, pushed to cover
this was banged in short on the body and Gayle pulled along the ground, looked a bit ungainly but kept it along the ground
fires a yorker outside off and it's a controlled glide to third man
slower ball on the pads and whipped away to fine leg
slower ball and he gets forward and drops it to the off side
he makes room to slog and misses and Gautam whips off the bails, Parthiv's back foot shifted slightly, but he's safe
he chips it down to long-off and it goes quickly to Pollard but for some reason they don't run! Pollard was also not deep at long-off
gives the charge and lofts just wide of mid-on, deep midwicket cuts it off
stays back and punches it to the off side
that was a clean slog, Parthiv shuffled across the stumps quickly and picked it from middle and slogged him over short fine leg
he goes back and chops it to the off side
the over costs four more! Suyal tries for the inswinging yorker and it's a low full toss and he whips it to deep midwicket, 28 off the over, nuff said
another one over long-off and this was higher in the air, pitched up and Gayle stays at the crease and takes him downtown again, over long-off
he bowls length and gets punished, a bit too straight, he has swing to the on side and over midwicket
Suyal bangs this in short and it's down the leg side and Gautam does well to take it one handed
down the ground! This was pitched up by Suyal, in Gayle's zone and he lofts through the line, a few rows over long-off
he drifts on the pads and he works it away down to Malinga at deep square leg
streaky though, it was chipped down the ground and Rayudu did really well at mid-on to throw himself to his right to try and pluck that, beat him and raced away
he totally lost control of that one! Too wide outside off and work for the keeper
he drifts too wide down the leg side, Parthiv looks to pull
pitched up ball on the stumps played down the track
this is fuller, and Parthiv gets a thick edge that flies past slip, was looking to play it to leg initially, then jabbed at it in the end
similar length, similar line, hurrying across him, Parthiv tries another pull now and is beaten again
and again, short, slanted across, quite some width, and Parthiv cuts in the gap between cover and backward point
dug in short again, and this time Parthiv goes off side, he is in the air as he slaps it well in front of square
sees this shortish ball angled across him, and tries a pull, ends up swinging over the line and is beaten
tries to thrash this pitched up delivery through the off side but short extra dives and takes pace off it
nice touch from Parthiv again, this is almost in the blockhole outside off, he opens the face and runs it past backward point
he moves it away again, but this is much fuller, Parthiv comes forward and times it superbly through extra cover
good length ball, going away from Parthiv, he punches to cover
back of a length, moving away a bit from the left-hander, who defends it square on the off side
starts off with a full toss around off, Gayle pushes it softly into the gap at extra cover for a single
